changes.title: Sam Altman backs Anthropic CEO’s call to slow down the global AI race
changes.summary: The CEOs of two of the world’s leading AI companies are publicly agreeing that the race to build increasingly powerful AI systems needs to be slowed, continuing this week’s cascade of warnings from researchers working on the technology.

changes.summary: Dario Amodei and Sam Altman are the latest to urge caution amid fears the industry is racing too fast to build powerful AI while safety measures lag. (Image credit: Karl Mondon).
